_about.rom: Models, textures, skeletons, animations and names are read from the US game (ULUS10391) by C:\MHFU-Extract\tools (DATA.BIN decrypted with the MHFU LookUp app's cipher notes; PAC/PMO/TMH/animation layouts after MHFU-ModKit's docs).
_about.not_rom: Monster classes and list order are the MHFU LookUp app's (monster_order.json); the names of variants the game calls by their base name are the LookUp app's too. Clips are the game's action entries, baked at its 30 Hz logic rate.
